name: io.github.sonnivasquez/gsc-mcp
title: Google Search Console MCP
description: Local, read-only Google Search Console MCP server. Quick Connect needs no Cloud project.

environmentVariables.name: GSC_AUTH_MODE
environmentVariables.description: oauth or service_account. Unset defaults to service_account. Set oauth for Quick Connect or your own OAuth client.

environmentVariables.name: GSC_ACCESS_MODE
environmentVariables.description: readonly or full. full enables gsc_submit_url, gsc_submit_batch, and gsc_submit_sitemap. When unset, legacy GSC_SCOPES and GSC_ENABLE_WRITE apply and writes stay off unless both allow them. Setup refuses full access for Quick Connect.

environmentVariables.name: GSC_SITE_URLS
environmentVariables.description: Property allowlist. JSON string array of exact Search Console property ids, a legacy comma-separated list, or all alone (or JSON ["all"]) for every current and future property. Property-scoped tools need an allowlist.

environmentVariables.name: GSC_KEY_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path to a service account JSON key. Required when GSC_AUTH_MODE is service_account, which is the default mode.

environmentVariables.name: GSC_DATA_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Local state directory for OAuth tokens and datasets. Default is ~/.gsc-mcp.

environmentVariables.name: GSC_EXPORTS
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to allow gsc_export_dataset and saved gsc_generate_report files on this machine. Any other value keeps local export disabled.

environmentVariables.name: GSC_OAUTH_SECRETS_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Optional path to a Desktop OAuth client secrets JSON file. It takes precedence over GSC_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID and GSC_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET. Quick Connect does not need it.

environmentVariables.name: GSC_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Optional OAuth client id. Used with GSC_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET when GSC_OAUTH_SECRETS_FILE is unset. Quick Connect does not need it.

environmentVariables.name: GSC_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Optional OAuth client secret paired with GSC_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID. Quick Connect does not need it.

environmentVariables.name: GSC_SCOPES
environmentVariables.description: Legacy scope tier, readonly or full. Ignored when GSC_ACCESS_MODE is set. full alone does not enable writes.

environmentVariables.name: GSC_ENABLE_WRITE
environmentVariables.description: Legacy write opt-in. Set to 1 together with GSC_SCOPES=full when GSC_ACCESS_MODE is unset. Ignored when GSC_ACCESS_MODE is set.
